title: Settlement, City, District & Street Cartography
objective: Implement urban cartographic authoring for districts, blocks, lots, streets and alleys, walls and gates, waterways, building footprints, landmarks and service markers, density patterns and reusable urban map styles while allowing Settlement/MBES data to seed or bind maps without duplicating or mutating canonical settlement or built-environment truth.

scope.purpose: Provide settlement/city/district/street cartography over completed MCS authoring foundations while preserving Settlement, World and built-environment owner truth outside the drawing system.
scope.completion_gate: Representative settlement and city maps can deterministically author and inspect districts, blocks, lots, streets/alleys, walls/gates, waterways, building footprints, landmarks/service markers, density patterns and reusable urban styles while Settlement/MBES data may seed or bind projections without being duplicated or mutated by drawing.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MCS-13 publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order; MCS-14 is next selected.
MCS-13 delivered deterministic district, block, lot, street/alley, wall/gate, waterway, building-footprint, landmark/service-marker, density-zone and reusable urban-style cartographic projections.

MIB-11/WCI and Settlement/MBES retained canonical settlement, world/location and built-environment truth; MCS-13 consumed explicit seed/binding references without creating owner ledgers, inferring links or mutating owner truth.
Generalized semantic binding and owner-version synchronization remained reserved to MCS-18.

Concurrent owner-authorized UISK-15 publication advanced application main during MCS-13. The stale validation base was rejected; the unchanged six-file MCS-13 delta was reconciled onto fresh main and fully revalidated before publication.
MCS-14, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work were not started by this execution.
next_action: MCS-13 is closed. MCS-14 is selected_not_started; wait for a later owner Continue before granting MCS-14 implementation authority.
